about.en: BABAon is the Ondo tokenized stock for Alibaba Group's NYSE-listed American depositary shares, issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited on the Ondo Global Markets platform and offered to eligible non-US investors. It is fully backed by BABA shares and is a total-return tracker: it gives the economic exposure of holding BABA with dividends reinvested, so one token does not necessarily equal one share. It is deployed on Ethereum (0x41765F0FCddC276309195166C7A62AE522FA09ef), BNB Chain, Solana and HyperEVM.
